merchant/30047.htm.text: Wharf Manager Firon: Are you here to board a ship? Nowadays there are only the regularly scheduled ships coming in and going out of Gludin Village, but before the troubles, when we used to trade with Gracia, there were many more ships in this port. That wretched war... I long to see this port as it…
